overall.summary: The structure, coverage and almost all numbers hold, but the Portugal claim C110 and its sentence state 31% where the model gives 18%, and the plain hypotheses of the two occupation parts name each other's occupation.

findings.evidence: recomputed risk.to 0.1837, delta -0.4366. Probe: part contribution -1.980 logit; score +0.491 -> -1.491 through the part = 18.4%. The whole-model value is 26.6% (C006); neither is 31%.
